Distance is not the same as a drawn line.

This tool measures raw GPS geometry, not V2 activity distance or active time. GPS drift can accumulate large raw chord lengths while you sit still. GPX lacks motion, steps, accuracy, pause states and power mode, so an exact sensor replay needs additional evidence.
